algorithm.action: Start from already frozen Creative Family and normalized Company Truth/Decision Signature.
Load Issue #44 research patterns compatible with Family and decision conditions.
Reject patterns/variants whose evidence, media or offer requirements are factually unavailable or whose incompatible conditions apply.
Choose the pattern whose persuasive mechanism directly resolves the current scene's decision job. No numeric pseudo-score is required; explicit rule precedence and rationale are mandatory.
Select a Production Variant implementing that pattern whose composition behavior matches the actual evidence/media/copy-density shape.
Assemble a page-level Variant Ensemble under one Art Direction Spine. Reject combinations that are individually premium but visually incoherent together.
Freeze pattern_ids + production_variant_ids before feasibility adaptation.

Apply feasibility only inside allowed variant adaptation boundaries. If required evidence/media is absent, downgrade within the same persuasive job or return HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED; never switch Family because assets are scarce.
Emit selected and rejected alternatives with reasons for every scene.

return_conditions: selected modules feel like unrelated premium components
all modules collapse to same card/section grammar
media geometry has no page-level rhythm
closing does not resolve opening/decision arc

same_family_rule: Two companies in the same Family may and often should select materially different module variants when their Decision Signature, evidence shape or company truth differs.
determinism_rule: Equivalent normalized semantic inputs must yield equivalent candidate reasoning. Diversity comes from real input differences and compatible authored variants, not randomness.
ambiguity_rule: If two materially different variants remain co-dominant after rule application and the difference affects whole-page art direction, return HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED rather than arbitrarily choose.
